verse.text: “Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

reflection.scripture: “Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
reflection.observation: Jesus highlights a principle of faithfulness in small things. The way we handle little responsibilities, unnoticed moments, and private choices reveals our true character. God cares deeply about our integrity in the mundane — not just the big, visible decisions.
reflection.application: Today, I will examine the 'very little' areas of my life — how I speak to family when no one else is around, how I steward my time, how I handle small commitments. I will choose faithfulness in one small thing I've been neglecting.
reflection.prayer: Lord, You see the hidden places of my heart. Help me be trustworthy in the small things — the quiet choices, the unseen moments, the daily disciplines. Grow my character so that when much is entrusted to me, I am ready. In Jesus' name, amen.
